english_outline.section1: Main conclusion: ASML beat Q2 2026 estimates and raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to EUR 43-45 billion, citing strong AI-driven demand. Reuters reported shares rose nearly 4%.
english_outline.section2: Core business changes: Installed Base Management sales were EUR 2.762 billion. ASML plans to expand EUV and DUV capacity by 30% annually for two years. CFO Dassen said pricing power has improved. CEO Fouquet said nearly all expanded EUV capacity through 2027 is booked.
english_outline.section3: Impact on growth, profit, cash flow expectations: Higher revenue guidance implies stronger growth. Pricing power could support margins. Capacity expansion requires investment but addresses bottleneck concerns. Q3 sales guidance is EUR 11-12 billion.
english_outline.section4: Market pricing: Shares rose 3.7% to EUR 1,613. JPMorgan said results could help close valuation gap with U.S. peers. Degroof Petercam analyst called results 'blow-out'. Analyst Marc Hesselink said easing lithography constraints is positive for the broader equipment ecosystem.
english_outline.section5: Next quarter's key business verification point: Whether ASML can execute its capacity expansion and maintain pricing power amid strong demand, and whether China sales remain stable at about 20% of total.

reader_questions: ASML 上调全年营收指引的幅度与口径究竟是什么——是净营收还是总营收，上调前后区间各是多少？
产能扩张 30% 的表述适用于哪些产品线，EUV 与 DUV 是否同步，且 2027 年前产能是否已全部被预订？
中国客户占比约 20% 这一数字对应的是哪一年、是销售额占比还是其他口径，与出口限制的关系如何？
checks: 官方来源显示 Q2 2026 销售额 93.26 亿欧元、毛利率 54.0%、净利润 29.18 亿欧元，Installed Base Management 销售额 27.62 亿欧元，Q3 指引 110 亿至 120 亿欧元；Reuters 报道全年净营收指引由 360 亿至 400 亿欧元上调至 430 亿至 450 亿欧元，中点增幅 16%。原稿数字与来源一致，但未点明“净营收”口径，需补正。
Reuters 报道公司计划未来两年每年将 EUV 产能扩大近三分之一，并同样提升 DUV 产能；CEO Fouquet 称截至 2027 年底的 EUV 产能几乎已全部被预订。原稿将 EUV 与 DUV 合并表述为“产能扩大约 30%”，需拆分并明确“近三分之一”与“几乎全部被预订”的限定。
Reuters 报道 CFO Dassen 重申中国客户预计占今年销售额约 20%，绝对额随总销售额上升而增加；公司因美国主导的出口限制不得在中国销售 EUV 及最好的 DUV 设备，但仍销售能力较低的 DUV。原稿未说明该比例为“今年销售额”口径，也未说明受限产品范围，需补足。
